title: Anyone else never on time in their dreams?
content: An absolute recurring theme for me is needing to be somewhere important and constantly getting stopped or held up along the way. Whether it’s a bathroom stop and it’s so dirty I go stall to stall looking for privacy and something clean, or I get lost on levels of level of a mall, or I’m walking and it’s taking forever. I’m an extremely on-time deadline driven person IRL so not sure if that’s connected somehow lol
